additional_info.subject: RE: ID0400223-DC/Si-D/FR - [hn7qqe] HMI not showing welcome screen CRM:00796001166
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Yes the charger is available and there is not any charge problems. It’s just that the 3 welcome screens are not shown in the HMI as usual (we only have a blue screen). We put those welcome screens on all the chargers (for example the charger rjge5U of the same station with 0,60 euros/ Kwh for the price). Can you put the welcome screens back in the charger please (you can take rjge5U as an example to put the same thing on hn7qqe).
Thank you,
Best Regards,
